BURNETT INLET TERMINAL HARVEST AREA TROLL FISHERY

The Burnett Inlet Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial salmon troll fishery will open for the harvest of chum, coho, sockeye, and pink salmon from 12:01 a.m., Saturday, June 27, 2026, until closed by emergency order. The Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association is forecasting a total return of approximately 426,000 hatchery-produced summer chum salmon and 11,600 hatchery-produced fall chum salmon to the Burnett Inlet THA.

The Burnett Inlet THA (statistical area 106-25) consists of the waters of Burnett Inlet north of 56°04.65′ N lat. Statistical area 106-25 should be recorded on fish tickets for harvest within the Burnett Inlet THA.

Chinook Salmon Landing Restrictions for Burnett Inlet THA: Chinook salmon retention is permitted only during general summer troll Chinook salmon retention periods established under 5 AAC 29.100.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E0426.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
